title: Marketplace Special Enrollment Period - basics
facts: Outside Open Enrollment, a person may enroll in or change Marketplace coverage if they qualify for a Special Enrollment Period.
Qualifying circumstances can include certain life events such as losing qualifying health coverage, marriage, having or adopting a child, or certain moves.
The exact enrollment window and documentation depend on the qualifying event.
Losing Marketplace coverage for nonpayment of premiums does not by itself create a Special Enrollment Period.
